templates.title: Name Correction Affidavit
templates.body: I solemnly affirm that both names belong to one and the same person.

templates.title: Residence Affidavit
templates.body: I hereby declare that I am residing at the stated address and the information furnished is true.

templates.title: Passport Loss Affidavit
templates.body: I affirm that my passport has been lost and despite reasonable efforts it could not be recovered.

templates.title: Employment Affidavit
templates.body: I solemnly declare that the employment details provided by me are true and correct.

templates.title: Single Status Affidavit
templates.body: I hereby affirm that I am unmarried and legally free to marry.
